contract: The absolute 30-second deadline still includes permit and blocking-executor queues.
Queue-only expiry becomes retryable after one-second cooldown; at most one attempt is Preparing for each key.
Waiting/Started/Expired transitions share a mutex, so a canceled queued operation cannot begin later.
Already-started failures and timeouts remain Failed, hold their permit until the worker returns and never accept late success.
The delayed Refresh uses current selection/settings and does not recreate stale entries.
boundaries: Controlled gates execute real async and blocking queues; no actual DLL hang is claimed.
No frontend, algorithm, detector limits or physical hardware changed.
